title: Move two objects
transferTask: Move two different objects in another scene without hints, then explain how the two positions differ.

completion.title: You changed two objects
completion.explanation: Two objects can have different positions in the same scene.
completion.why: Each placed object has its own transform, even when both use the same model.
hints: Choose two objects and give them different positions.
Select an object, use Move, and change one axis. Repeat with a different object.

steps.title: Move one object
steps.explanation: Choose an object and change where it sits in the scene.
steps.why: Position is part of this placed object, so the same model can appear in different places.
steps.completionFeedback: Good. Choose a different object for the next move.
hints: Select any object in the scene.
Choose Move, then change one axis in the Inspector.

steps.title: Move a different object
steps.explanation: Choose another object and give it a position of its own.
steps.why: A scene is a group of independent placements, not one transform shared by every model.
steps.completionFeedback: You changed two objects. Now try the transfer task without hints.
hints: Select an object other than the one you just moved.
Change one axis on a second object and compare the two positions.
